quest.heroesjourney.batman.2.description: Learn to watch without being seen: approach hostile mobs while staying undetected.

puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.1.question: A liar always repeats the exact same story, word for word. What gives him away?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.1.a: It never varies, not even on insignificant details
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.1.b: He speaks louder than everyone else
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.1.c: He keeps looking at the ground
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.2.question: A safe was opened without any sign of forced entry. What should you suspect first?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.2.b: An accomplice who knew the combination
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.3.question: Two witnesses give different times for the same event. What should you do?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.3.c: Check each witness's watch and movements
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.4.question: A criminal always leaves the same symbol at his crime scenes. What does this reveal?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.4.a: A need to claim credit for his acts
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.5.question: Why does a burglar carefully avoid nights with a full moon?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.6.question: What detail most often gives away a hastily fabricated alibi?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.6.a: A perfectly calm tone of voice
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.7.question: A guard claims to have seen nothing all night. What should you verify first?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.7.a: Whether he was actually at his post
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.8.question: Why do some criminals return to the scene of their crime?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.8.b: To make sure no evidence was left behind
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.9.question: What is the best time to observe a scene without being seen?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.9.a: Standing in the middle of the street
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.9.b: Speaking loudly to draw attention away
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.9.c: From the heights, in the shadows
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.10.question: A forged document is most often recognised by what?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.10.a: Ink or handwriting that doesn't match
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.10.b: The colour of the paper used
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.11.question: Why watch a target's habits closely before acting?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.11.b: To spot a gap in their routine
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.12.question: A suspect has clean hands but fresh paint on his shoes. What should you do?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.12.c: Check where that paint was recently used
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.13.question: What sign most often betrays a recently used hideout?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.14.question: Why does a good interrogation often start with harmless questions?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.14.b: To put the suspect at ease before the key questions
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.15.question: A coded message keeps reusing the same rare symbols. What should you do first?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.15.c: Count how often each symbol appears
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.16.question: Why keep watch on unusual deliveries to an isolated warehouse?
puzzle.heroesjourney.riddle.16.c: It's never useful to an investigation
